purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
assessment: An official city cadastral-map visualization query service exists, but the public documentation points to registered-user and certificate-specific flows. No anonymous geometry-only request was made, no schema/allowlist was verified, and no polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: The Baoji Natural Resources and Planning Bureau identifies the Baoji Real Estate Registration Center and documents city-level real-estate registration, information inquiry, and a cadastral-map visualization query service. The service is described as convenient and security-focused and is linked to a WeChat service account; its documented certificate QR/registered-user workflows are not an anonymous geometry-only contract. This confirms a local registry, not open parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Baoji bureau performance self-evaluation says an online real-estate registration-information and cadastral-map visualization query service went live on September 9, 2025; it reports visit counts, but does not document a public vector API/schema.

Baoji bureau 2026 page describes the city registration center and security-focused real-property information query service; companion information says service-account registration uses identity-document recognition. No registration was attempted.

Baoji bureau registration notice describes using the “Baoji Real Estate” WeChat service account and scanning a property certificate QR code to retrieve its parcel map/floor plan; this is a certificate-specific route and was not used.
The bureau’s forms and 2025 handling guide confirm local registration services, but do not expose a geometry-only service contract.
